description: This file defines a PHP trait that provides utility functions for parsing AWS credentials and config files in INI format, as well as retrieving the user's home directory across different operating systems.

classes.name: ParsesIniTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing static methods to load AWS profiles from ini files and to determine the user's home directory.

methods.name: loadProfiles
methods.description: Reads AWS profile data from a specified ini file and merges it with the default config file if available. Standardizes profile names.

methods.name: getHomeDir
methods.description: Attempts to determine the current user's home directory across different operating systems.
